title: Top K Frequent Elements
description:
Given an integer array `nums` and an integer `k`, return the `k` **most frequent** elements. You may return them in any order.

The test data guarantees that the answer is unique (there is no tie for the `k`-th place). Try to beat O(n log n).
constraints: 1 <= k <= number of distinct elements in nums
hints: Count occurrences with a hash map first.
Bucket sort by frequency (frequency can be at most n), or keep a min-heap of size k.
